claims.evidence: Location is not shown in photo 0.
Photo 0 shows a “NEXUS” label on the machine front, not Midea.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (seller says Midea but photo shows “NEXUS”), which affects parts availability and comparable pricing.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the washing machine rating plate/model sticker (usually on the back or inside the lid) showing brand and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unverified top-loader (worst case for value due to possible wrong identity).

risks.risk: Unknown capacity (kg) and wash type (semi-auto vs fully automatic), which strongly affects price.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate showing capacity (e.g., 6kg/7kg/8kg) and whether it is fully automatic.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for used top-loaders until capacity is confirmed.

risks.risk: Condition/working status not shown (could have issues like weak spin, drainage problems, or noisy motor).
risks.proof: Short video of a full wash cycle (fill → wash → drain → spin) or at least a spin test with water.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case).

risks.risk: Missing/defective accessories (inlet hose, drain hose, power cord, lid/hinges) not visible.
risks.proof: Photos showing all included accessories: inlet hose, drain hose, power cord, and lid/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories may be missing or not included.

risks.risk: Electrical compatibility (Nigeria voltage) and safety condition not verifiable from the photo.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate showing voltage (e.g., 220–240V) and a photo of the plug/cord condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price with a safety/compatibility discount until confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating plate/model sticker showing brand, model number, voltage, and capacity.
Video of the machine running a complete cycle (or at minimum: fill + drain + spin).
Photos of inlet hose, drain hose, power cord/plug, and lid/hinges to confirm accessories and physical condition.
A photo of the control panel/buttons clearly showing the program options (to confirm fully automatic vs semi-auto).
response.reason: The photo shows a “NEXUS” label while the seller claims “Midea,” so the identity is not reliable. Without the model/capacity and a working test, a correct worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
